issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one immutable release-tail admission record for the converged milestone candidate, including a findings-first gap analysis that proves planned execution and implementation outcomes are accounted for.

## Primary deliverable

One immutable release-tail admission record indexing every reviewed-green ancestral execution root, plus machine-readable and human-readable gap-analysis artifacts comparing the complete v0.92.1 expected baseline with observed implementation, validation, review, documentation, integration, and closeout evidence.

## Verification result

The admission validator reports the exact root denominator, revisions, artifacts, ancestry, and zero unresolved collisions. The folded gap analysis reports the complete expected-versus-observed denominator and classifies every mismatch as a release blocker, durable proof gap, routed follow-on, stale readiness documentation, non-blocking quality concern, or evidence-backed no-gap result.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one admission decision. Lane receipts and the folded gap analysis are evidence inputs; lane remediation remains separately owned. This issue identifies and routes gaps but does not implement child fixes.

## Gap-analysis denominator

For every planned v0.92.1 issue and retained predecessor dependency, compare the authoritative issue acceptance criteria, execution specification, and milestone plan against:

- merged implementation and exact ancestral revision
- production/runtime call paths rather than test-only or placeholder presence
- focused and integration validation with meaningful behavior coverage
- current exact-head review findings and dispositions
- documentation and demo claims
- PR linkage, merge, lifecycle, and closeout truth
- explicitly deferred or backlogged scope with a resolvable owner

Absence of evidence is recorded as missing evidence or scope ambiguity, not silently treated as success. Any unresolved P0/P1 implementation, execution, test, integration, documentation-truth, or closeout gap blocks admission.

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every lane is reviewed, merged, and ancestral
- [ ] Exact revisions and artifacts are indexed
- [ ] Cross-lane collisions are resolved by owners
- [ ] The complete planned issue and retained-predecessor denominator is enumerated with no silently omitted work
- [ ] Expected acceptance criteria are compared with observed production implementation and execution evidence
- [ ] Test-only, placeholder, do-nothing, partially wired, or unexecuted implementations are identified rather than admitted as complete
- [ ] Missing validation, stale review, documentation drift, and closeout overclaims are classified and routed
- [ ] Every gap has severity, source evidence, disposition, and an existing owner or explicit release-blocking status
- [ ] No unresolved P0/P1 gap remains in the admitted candidate
- [ ] Gap-analysis Markdown and JSON artifacts are retained and indexed by the admission record

## Owned paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/integration/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/DEMO_MATRIX_v0.92.1.md`

## PVF lanes

- `merged-authority-census`
- `ancestry`
- `artifact-index`
- `collision-check`
- `expected-observed-gap-analysis`
- `production-path-implementation-check`
- `validation-review-closeout-truth-check`

## Stop conditions

- Any lane lacks reviewed merged authority
- Evidence revisions disagree
- The expected issue or acceptance denominator is incomplete
- A required behavior exists only as a stub, test fixture, unused code path, or unsupported claim
- Any unresolved P0/P1 gap or unowned material gap remains

## Non-goals

- Implementing child fixes
- Creating duplicate remediation issues when an owner already exists
- Release approval
